behavior.query: Previous movement segment against all enabled source rail segments; 100 original-unit broadphase and strict distance below 100. The grounded rail point cannot lie above the native Y-down motion origin.

behavior.endpoints: Travel direction comes from incoming 3D velocity. Reject an outward endpoint, then continue searching eligible rails; ties retain reverse activation order.
behavior.origin: Native Y-down origin is 30 native units above collision contact. The frame converts the registered world coordinates; no rail node or source collision vertex moved.
behavior.input: Current press or hold required; a legacy released-input grace cannot catch. Source-profile departure cooldown is five 30 Hz ticks.
